Library-hold fixtures for `velocitron codegen`.

A circulation desk files a hold, lends or recalls the copy, checks it out,
and notices when it is overdue. A newer edition can cancel a hold that has
not reached the desk. A partner-library loan refines the checkout's borrow
step, and a union-catalog watch records whether that copy was shelved.
A separate branch-policy net is the actor-filter example: the board and the
annex own most steps, and the circulation desk owns the quiet-day alarm.

These nets are original examples. They exercise composition, refinement,
shares, kept records, timers, waits, guards, correlate, inhibit, carry, and
codegen. They are not a relabeling of any earlier diagram.
